name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region found on 13 Nov; US nor'easter brings mostly rain
state: A low moving from the Ohio Valley to the US Northeast on 12–14 Nov was forecast to bring mostly rain to Philadelphia, New York and Washington, with accumulating snow confined to higher ground in the Appalachians and interior New England (FOX 5 DC, 10 Nov). Searches on 13 Nov found no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region and no cold-related power or gas outages. The trend stays up because the Met Office said on 4 Nov that a possible sudden stratospheric warming raises the chance of UK cold from mid-November.
for_you: No major cold hazard now. Drivers on high routes in the Appalachians and interior New England may meet snow to 14 Nov. In the UK, the Met Office publishes any cold or snow warnings.
rubric_hit: Normal: no major cold wave or winter-storm warning affecting large populations found as of 13 Nov

sources.title: FOX 5 DC — Will it snow? Latest on potential nor'easter headed for Philly, NYC and DC

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
